scenario.name: Loss of Autoware while driving
scenario.description: Autoware's commands stop, freeze or become implausible while driving in lane; other road users then pass the vehicle stopped in lane

events.description: After a fault in planning or control, keeps driving without control instead of stopping

goals.statement: Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely

scenario.meant: the monitor stops it in lane
scenario.pass: The monitor detects the loss within its detection budget and stops the vehicle in lane with hazard lights on, without Autoware; a fault of the monitor itself leads to the vehicle's own stop, never to the park brake while moving

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 30 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h; picked, not seeded)

legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: the monitor stops it in lane
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-07.1 After a fault in planning or control, keeps driving without control instead of stopping

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
